command:
python3 -c "
import hashlib, pathlib, re
files = ['src/sloplab/experiments/resolved_recipe.py', 'src/sloplab/experiments/study.py', 'src/sloplab/cli/main.py', 'src/sloplab/experiments/input_identity.py', 'src/sloplab/scoring/harness.py', 'src/sloplab/experiments/pilot.py', 'src/sloplab/evaluators/llm/adapter.py', 'src/sloplab/experiments/runner.py', 'src/sloplab/experiments/config.py', 'src/sloplab/models/suite.py', 'src/sloplab/evaluators/base.py', 'tests/regression/test_resolved_recipe.py']
lines = []
for f in files:
    h = hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', h), f
    lines.append(f'{h}  {f}')
pathlib.Path('docs/reviews/issue-05/E1e/hashes-end.txt').write_text(chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10))
print(len(lines), 'hashes validated 64-hex')
"
